description: This file defines a generic client implementation for Kubernetes API interactions, including conversion between different API versions, handling of watch interfaces, and utility functions for resource management within the 'client' package.

classes.name: convertingClient
classes.description: A generic client that handles resource operations with support for multiple API versions and conversion between them.

classes.name: callSequence
classes.description: A helper struct to manage API call retries across different API versions.

classes.name: watchSomething
classes.description: A wrapper for watch.Interface that handles event conversion and stopping.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a resource, with version conversion if necessary.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates a resource, with version conversion if necessary.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status subresource of a resource, with version conversion if necessary.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a resource by name, with conversion.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the API call with retries across versions.

methods.name: putWithConversion
methods.description: Converts resource object to different API version, executes call, and converts back.

methods.name: getWithConversion
methods.description: Retrieves resource and converts between versions.

methods.name: watchWithConversion
methods.description: Wraps watch interface to handle event conversion.
